title: Valid Palindrome - Solution
approach: Two pointers checking characters after filtering.
intuition: A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase characters into lowercase and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Two pointers checking characters after filtering.
common_mistakes: Use two pointers from opposite ends. Skip non-alphanumeric characters.
